name: Lyo.Translation
tagline: **Archetype B (capability).** Providers (`Lyo.Translation.Google`, `Lyo.Translation.Aws`) remain under `Communication/Translation/`, not under `Integration/`. See package layout.
description:
**Archetype B (capability).** Providers (`Lyo.Translation.Google`, `Lyo.Translation.Aws`) remain under `Communication/Translation/`, not `Integration/`. See [package layout](../../../docs/package-layout.md).

Contracts and shared translation behavior: `ITranslationService`, `TranslationServiceBase` (bulk pipeline, metrics, lifecycle events), error codes, metric key names, and a small DI helper.

**Target frameworks:** `netstandard2.0;net10.0`

examples.title: Injection helpers

sections.title: `ITranslationService`
rows: `TranslateAsync(string text, LanguageCodeInfo targetLanguageCode, LanguageCodeInfo? sourceLanguage = null, CancellationToken ct = default)`
Convenience overload. Builds a `TranslationRequest` and applies `Options.DefaultSourceLanguage` when the caller leaves source unset.
Bulk send capped by concurrency. Returns `IReadOnlyList<TranslationResult>`.
Detects the language of `text` and returns `LanguageCodeInfo`. Providers may return unknown info on failure.

sections.title: `TranslationServiceBase`
items: Shared bulk pipeline using a `SemaphoreSlim` sized by `TranslationServiceOptions.BulkTranslationConcurrencyLimit` and a hard per-call cap of `TranslationServiceOptions.MaxBulkTranslationLimit`.
Bulk results land in a `ConcurrentBag`, so output order is not guaranteed to match input order.
A `MetricNames` dictionary that providers may override in the constructor.

sections.title: `TranslationServiceOptions`
rows: Provider fallback used when the caller omits a target.
Source language used when callers leave it unset.
Upper bound on text length providers should accept.
Upper bound on requests in one `TranslateBulkAsync` call.

sections.title: Default metric keys (`Lyo.Translation.Constants.Metrics`)
sections.trail: Provider packages (Google, AWS) override `CreateMetricNamesDictionary` to put a namespace on these.

sections.title: Injection helpers
sections.text: `Lyo.Translation.Extensions` exposes a generic helper used by provider packages. It wires `TOptions`, `TService`, and `ITranslationService` (resolved from `TService`) as singletons. Concrete provider packages (`Lyo.Translation.Google`, `Lyo.Translation.Aws`) wrap this in their own `Add*FromConfiguration` extensions that also wire native SDK clients.
